appDesc.message: Learn English while you browse: swaps Vietnamese or English words for SAT/CEFR vocabulary, with hover learning cards.

actionTitle.message: Merid - learn English while you browse

popupIntensityHint_casual.message: Up to 1 word per short post, 2–3 in a long article.

popupIntensityOff.message: Currently replacing nothing. Move the slider to switch it back on.

popupIntensityHint_focused.message: Up to 1 word per short post, 2–4 as the article gets longer.

popupIntensityHint_locked.message: Up to 2 words per short post, 3–5 as the article gets longer.

popupSiteOn.message: Turn back on for this site

popupSiteAlwaysOffHint.message: Merid never changes words on its own site.

aiModalTitle.message: Get the most out of Merid ✨

aiModalSub.message: Turn on AI Context Check and Merid checks that every swapped word fits its sentence. Words that do not fit change back on their own. All you need is your own free Gemini API key, pasted once:

aiModalStep1.message: Open aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with Google.

aiModalStep2.message: Click Create API key, then copy the key (it starts with "AIza…").

aiModalStep3.message: In Merid Settings → AI context check, paste the key and press Save key.

popupAiStateOff.message: Off - add your Gemini API key in Settings to switch it on.

popupAiStateError.message: Could not reach Gemini. Check your key in Settings.

popupAiStateFixed.message: Checked every swapped word against its sentence.

popupAiStateClean.message: Checked every swapped word - all of them fit.

popupAiCachedNote.message: answers reused from cache cost nothing

popupLearnReview1.message: 1 saved word brought back for review

popupLearnReviewN.message: %d saved words brought back for review

popupLearnHidden.message: %d words skipped - you already know them
